app.name: mirrord
app.one_liner: Run local code as if it were a pod in a remote Kubernetes cluster: real env vars, DNS, network, traffic.

screens.name: Mirrord Main Interface
screens.purpose: Enable users to select a target pod and activate mirrord to run their local process in the context of the remote Kubernetes environment.

rust_commands.name: enable_mirrord
rust_commands.purpose: Activate mirrord interception for a local process using the default kubeconfig to connect to the Kubernetes cluster.

mvp_plan: week 1: Proxy network and environment variables from remote pod
acceptance_tests: Local process successfully resolves DNS and accesses services as if running inside the selected Kubernetes pod.
mirrord correctly handles IPv4 fallback when IPv6 setup fails in clusters with IPv6 disabled.
